content.text: Iron came in by sea and left as nails. Josef counted the crates twice. The harbourmaster did not trust him.
The foundry ran all night. Its windows glowed like a stove. Josef slept beside the furnace.
The storm came in from the west. It took the pier first. Its windows glowed like a stove.
